digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate dependency hashing and invalidation
propositions: Container tickets with empty file_impact declarations fall back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing unnecessary re-reviews on every commit regardless of actual code changes affected.

A container's plan-review attestation should inherit the union of its direct children's declared file_impact under a poison rule: if any non-closed child lacks file_impact, inheritance is disabled and the pre-change (empty) set is retained.
Closed children must not contribute to or poison the inherited file_impact union, since their work is complete and later drift belongs to other tickets.
Child file_impact edits must invalidate the container attestation via pin/material drift, and unrelated commits must not invalidate when inheritance is effective.
The P9 determinism floor check must emit an advisory (never blocking) naming non-closed children with empty file_impact to surface why a container remains on whole-HEAD invalidation.
